title: USB-C earbuds & cord organizers

recommendation.title: Sound first: QUARK 2 + Cableyoyo
recommendation.text: About $26.98 with green, $27.10 with dark grey, before shipping/tax. Manual winding—not automatic retraction. Fonus is the closest all-in-one, but its sound quality is unproven.
recommendation.test: Amazon dates are signed-out advertised offers, checked Nov 6 for NYC—not confirmed for your account. No earbud–organizer pairing has been physically tested.

products.name: Fonus USB-C retractable earbuds

facts.Delivery: Advertised Prime Nov 9; non-Prime Nov 12 free on $35 eligible order. Not account-confirmed.
facts.Evidence: Black in-ear buds; ABS reel; microphone; pull both ends together. No independent acoustic or durability testing found. Universal USB-C claim is seller wording, not device-specific proof. In stock; sold by FONUS Direct, ships Amazon.
facts.Pairing: No physical pairing or handset test. Keep inline remote and Y-split outside tight windings.
